items.title: Introducing yourself
items.theme: self-introduction: your name, where you are from, nice to meet you

phrases.note: Only for the very first meeting. It always comes first.
Put your own name before です (desu). You can say わたしは (watashi wa) first, but people often leave it out.

phrases.text: よろしくお願いします
phrases.meaning: nice to meet you, I look forward to knowing you
phrases.note: Said at the end of an introduction. There is no exact English match.

phrases.meaning: I'm from Canada (literally: I came from Canada)
phrases.note: Swap in your own country before から (kara).

dialogue.text: はじめまして。サラです。
dialogue.meaning: Nice to meet you. I'm Sara.

dialogue.text: はじめまして。田中です。サラさんは、どちらからですか。
dialogue.romanization: Hajimemashite. Tanaka desu. Sara-san wa, dochira kara desu ka.
dialogue.meaning: Nice to meet you. I'm Tanaka. Where are you from, Sara?

dialogue.text: カナダから来ました。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.romanization: Kanada kara kimashita. Yoroshiku onegai shimasu.
dialogue.meaning: I'm from Canada. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.text: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします。

practice.question: How would you say "Nice to meet you. I'm Sara."?
practice.answer: はじめまして。サラです。(Hajimemashite. Sara desu.)

practice.question: Someone says よろしくお願いします (yoroshiku onegai shimasu) to you. How do you reply?
practice.answer: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします。(Kochira koso, yoroshiku onegai shimasu.)

practice.question: How do you politely ask a new person where they are from?
practice.answer: どちらからですか。(Dochira kara desu ka.)

practice.question: Tanaka asks you: どちらからですか. Sara answers カナダから来ました. What did she say?
practice.answer: I'm from Canada. Literally: I came from Canada.

items.say_aloud: Introduce yourself in three lines: はじめまして。(your name)です。よろしくお願いします。(Hajimemashite. ... desu. Yoroshiku onegai shimasu.) Say it three times, slowly. Bow a little on the last line.
